blocks.text: Kisi shell mein ‘d’ orbitals ki shapes aur space mein orientations alag hain. dxy, dxz aur dyz respectively (isi tarteeb se) xy, xz aur yz planes mein hain (axes ke beech). dx²−y² ke lobes x aur y axes par hain. dz² ke do lobes z-axis par hain aur xy plane mein ek “doughnut” (chhalla) hai.
ℓ = 2 wale paanch d orbitals ki shapes Figure 2.7 mein hain.

blocks.alt: x, y aur z axes par paanch 3d orbitals, kitab ki tarteeb mein: dz2 (z par do lobes aur xy plane mein chhalla), dx2-y2 (x aur y axes par chaar lobes), dxy (x aur y ke beech chaar lobes), dyz (y aur z ke beech chaar lobes) aur dxz (x aur z ke beech chaar lobes). Bhare aur safed lobes ulte phase dikhate hain.

blocks.text: f subshell ke space mein saat orientations hain, yani saat f orbitals. Magar f orbitals ki shapes bohat complicated (pechida) hain.

blocks.prompt: a) Wave mechanical model ke mutabiq orbital kya dikhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Orbital nucleus ke gird space ka woh hissa hai jahan electron ke milne ki probability (imkaan) sab se zyada hai. Yeh Bohr ke orbit jaisa pakka raasta nahi, balke probability ka area hai, jise n, ℓ aur m batate hain.

blocks.prompt: b) Magnetic quantum number ki teen qeematon ki wajah se p-orbital ke teen orientations hain. Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: p subshell ke liye ℓ = 1, to m ki 2ℓ + 1 = 3 qeematein hain: −1, 0, +1. Har qeemat space mein ek orientation hai, is liye teen p orbitals px, py aur pz hain jo teen aapas mein perpendicular axes par hain.

items: Paanch d orbitals: dxy, dxz, dyz axes ke beech; dx²−y² x aur y par; dz² z par chhalle ke saath.
Saat f orbitals, bohat complicated shapes.
